spans.s: --an apsaras with the sun in the spring. वा. ५२. 4.
(I)--a son of ब्रह्मा born of his hand; Married क्रिया, daughter of Kardama. His sons were the वाल- khilyas. Had not realised the Supreme
(II)--a son of Ulmuka and पुष्करिणी. भा. IV. १३. १७.
(IV)--a son of कृष्ण and जाम्बवती. भा. X. ६१. १२.
(V)--a ब्राह्मण invited for the राजसुय of युधिष्ठिर. भा. X. ७४. 8.
(VI)--(ऋटु-ब्र्। प्।) the यक्ष presiding over the month of तपस्य (फाल्गुण). भा. XII. ११. ४०. [page१-477+ ३०]

(VII)--created from अपान of ब्रह्मा, as ancient as सनत्कुमार and a yogin;
1: Br.
(XI)--a son of भृगु and a deva. Lives in Bhuvarlokam. Br.
(XIII)--a son of Vijaya, and father of Sunaya. Br. III. ६४. २२.
(XV)--a son of आग्नेयी and Uru (Kuru-वि। प्।).
(XVI)--a sage of the स्वायम्भुव epoch. वा. ३१. १६.

(XVIII)--a mind-born son of ब्रह्मा married to क्षमा;
1: Vi.

and 7.
travelling with the sun in the month of पौष.
2: Ib. II. १०. १४.
(XXI)--a R. from the रिक्ष hill. Br. II. १६. ३१.
(XXII)--the name of the seventh kalpa. वा. २१. ३०.
--Dhaiva, यश, वाम, Gopa, देवायत, Aja, दुरोण, आप, Mahanja, चिकित्वान्, all सोमपायिन्स्. वा. ६२. 9-१२.
--the वेदव्यास of the seventeenth द्वा- पर। Vi.

--the apsaras designated पञ्चचूडा; यक्ष loved her and wandered through the नन्दन to meet her; found her in the midst of other apsarases; assuming the guise of Gandharva Vasuruci he approached her; she yielded and gave birth to सम्सिद्धकरण (राजबुनाभ-ब्र्। प्।); then he showed her his real form; on this the angry and fearful Apsaras ran away; she became thence-forward Yak- षमाता; then she and her son went to यक्षा's house.
1: Br.

. १०१-17; वा. ६९. १३६-50.
Resides in the sun's chariot in the month of चैत्र
--a son of Vidarbha, and father of Kunti. भा. IX. २४. 1 and 3; Br. III. ७०. ३७; M. ४४. ३६-8; Vi. IV. १२. ३७, ४०.
--a son of खशा, and a राक्षस; an asura in the सभा of हिरण्यकशिपु. Br.
--the city of a राक्षस in the Sutalam. वा. ५०. २२.
--one of the ten branches of the सुकर्मण group of devas. Br.
--a R. in the प्लक्षद्वीप. Br. II. १९. १९.
--one of the four forms of marriage; this is दासी। Br. IV. १५. 4.
--the profession of the वैश्यस्, not of the ब्राह्मणस्. वा. ७९. ७७.
--a son of क्षाम who consumes dead human beings. Br. II. १२. ३७; वा. २९. ३५.
--a class of Rurus (s.v.) in महारौरव hell. भा. V. २६. 2.
--pupils of कृत generally desig- nated as. Br. II. ३५. ५४.
